purpose: Quantify the independent-component sample size required for specified conditional operating characteristics without estimating the probability that the actual model will pass.
forbidden: reading raw development, calibration, deployment-confirmation, or mechanism-confirmation outcomes
stating a conditional operating characteristic as an actual pass probability
altering the frozen Task15I redevelopment contract

screen.interpretation: Probability that an independent redevelopment point estimate reaches 0.005 if the true increment is 0.01.

confirmation_like.interpretation: Probability that a nominal 95% lower bound exceeds 0.005 if the true increment is 0.01.

adoption_rule: This analysis is nonbinding. Any increase beyond the frozen Task15I 1,200-pair, 300-component design requires a new prelabel redevelopment contract version and a new independent sampling feasibility audit.
claim_boundary: Results are conditional on declared synthetic effect, variance, and dependence assumptions. They are not a forecast of the actual model result or a route to bypass model qualification.
